snippet.title: LIMINOID Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4927530/LIMINOID/

LIMINOID is an immersive first-person exploration game set in dream-like liminal spaces. Explore, admire and progress throughout surreal landscapes and labyrinth structures that should not exist.
